title: Give the dashboard a dark theme

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-278#dashboard-dark-theme

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision.** SEED-278#dashboard-dark-theme (`.planning/seeds/SEED-278-dashboard-dark-theme.md#dashboard-dark-theme`), plan `.planning/slice-plans/578-dashboard-dark-theme/PLAN.md`. Checked product tip `53fd020780ae447e7ee00363e2ab49a9f055f2f0` (“Give the dashboard a coherent system dark appearance”), which isolates the dark-theme product better than later planning tip `6df10272c59d473a791a248d55800ca281756c5c`. Isolated detached scratch worktree at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-278-dashboard-dark-theme-scratch` (pre-probe: only `?? node_modules` symlink; 0 product paths dirty). Execution checkout unused for edits.
- **Promise.** Key examples 3–4: under a dark system preference, highlighted Intent source tokens stay readable on their composed dark background; light↔dark preference changes update those tokens without losing reading place.
- **Fault.** In `dashboard/src/source-lines.css`, the dark `prefers-color-scheme` rule for `.source-token` used `color: var(--shiki-light)` instead of `color: var(--shiki-dark, var(--shiki-light))`. Fixture and assertions stayed unchanged. A shell `trap` restored `git checkout -- dashboard/src/source-lines.css` on exit.
- **Fixture.** `dashboard/frontend-tests/dashboard-system-appearance.spec.ts` opens the real built app via `openFrontendTakenBacklog` with MakeMe Intent locations for a TypeScript highlighted file (`export const message = "hello";`) and a plain `.check` file, starting in dark scheme.
- **Maintained assertion.** Same spec, Intent source step line 168: `await expectReadableContrast(exportToken)` (≥ 4.5:1 for the `export` token on its composed background). The later live-flip check `expect(lightExport).not.toBe(darkExport)` (line 200) was not reached after the contrast failure.
- **Run observations.**
  - Baseline: `caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- dashboard/frontend-tests/dashboard-system-appearance.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=line` — 1 passed (6.1 s). The selected test ran.
  - Faulted: 1 failed. Board/Sessions/settings steps passed. Reach is evidenced by entering “Intent source highlights and plain text follow the scheme without losing place”, finding the visible `export` token, then failing `expectReadableContrast(exportToken)` with Expected ≥ 4.5, Received ≈ 3.9255 (`contrast of export` at `tests/accessibleReading.ts:109`). Wrong behavior on the intended path: light github-light token colour on the dark source surface. The live colour-change assertion was not reached.
  - Restoration: after `git checkout -- dashboard/src/source-lines.css`, `git status --porcelain` again showed only `?? node_modules` (matching pre-probe) and `git diff` for the fault file was empty. The same focused command then passed 1 of 1 (6.4 s). Scratch worktree removed with `git worktree remove --force`; execution workspace `dashboard/src/source-lines.css` stayed unmodified.

### Cost

- **Test runtime.** Measured. Playwright-reported: baseline 6.1 s; restored 6.4 s. Faulted run: Playwright printed `1 failed` without a suite total; shell wall clock for the faulted focused command was about 5.5 s within the combined fault/restore script (~11.9 s for both fault and restore runs together after the edit).
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no human took part in the check, and there is no separate measure.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable: no separately supported measure of agent tokens or active time is available to this agent.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 62008 ms (measured), from 1794322019097 to 1794322081105 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
